entities.name: Charles Demôle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Demôle was a French politician of the French Third Republic. He was minister of public works in the government of Henri Brisson. He was minister of justice in the government of Charles de Freycinet. He was a member of the Senate of France from January 5, 1879, until his death. He served twice as vice-president of the French Senate.
